[[File:Willow longbow detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''willow longbow''' is a [[Longbow (weapon)|longbow]] made from [[willow logs]]. It requires 20 [[Ranged]] to equip and can fire arrows up to [[Mithril arrow|mithril]]. It has a longer [[attack range]] than its [[Willow shortbow|shortbow]] counterpart, but has a slower [[attack speed]]. It can be purchased from [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] in [[Varrock]].

Willow longbows can be created at level 40 [[Fletching]] by using a [[knife]] on willow logs to create a [[willow longbow (u)]], granting 41.5 experience, and then using a [[bowstring]] on the unstrung bow, granting another 41.5 experience.

Fletching a willow longbow from [[willow logs]] and a [[bow string]] will profit {{Coins|{{GEP|Willow longbow}}-({{GEP|Willow logs}}+{{GEP|Bow string}})}} while fletching a willow longbow from a [[willow longbow (u)]] and a [[bow string]] will profit {{Coins|{{GEP|Willow longbow}}-({{GEP|Willow longbow (u)}}+{{GEP|Bow string}})}}.

Four willow longbows are required in the quest [[Shadows of Custodia]].
